title: Payload of `node.action`
description: gateway → node: an action to run, authorised only by the core-signed `authz` (§7.1). `seq` is the stream chunk's sequence number, unsigned, so the node's live `action.receipt` can name it (R12-36). Core accepts `(reply_id, seq)` only for an ACTION chunk of that reply for this node and person, so a wrong `seq` can only get the receipt refused or point it at another action of the same reply to the same node.

seq.description: The ACTION chunk's `seq` in its reply (unsigned, R12-36).
